title: client_id is not a registered relying-party identifier
source: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/848, Art. 3 + OpenID4VP Client Identifier Prefixes
why: A wallet resolves the relying party from the prefix of client_id. A bare URL carries no registration entry, so a conformant wallet cannot show who is asking and may refuse the request.

title: Credential query has no purpose string
why: The relying party must inform the user which attributes it needs and for what purpose. A DCQL credential entry without a purpose leaves the wallet consent screen blank.

title: Request asks for a whole credential instead of named claims
why: A credential query with no claims array releases every attribute in the credential. Registration under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/848 lists the attributes you may request, and an open query does not match it.

title: birth_date requested where an age attestation exists
why: The PID carries age_equal_or_over flags for exactly this case. Asking for the date of birth when a boolean answers the question is more data than the purpose needs.

title: response_mode direct_post sends the vp_token unencrypted
source: EUDI Wallet Architecture and Reference Framework, response encryption
why: direct_post posts the presentation in the clear to the response endpoint. The wallet profile expects direct_post.jwt so the vp_token is encrypted to the relying party key.

title: No nonce in the authorization request
why: Without a nonce the presentation is not bound to this request and a captured vp_token can be replayed against your endpoint.

title: Authorization request is neither signed nor fetched by request_uri
source: EUDI Wallet Architecture and Reference Framework, signed request objects
why: An unsigned request cannot be tied to the certificate behind your client_id, so the wallet has nothing to check the registered identity against.

title: Relying-party registration or certificate window has passed
source: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/848, national register of relying parties
why: A registration date already in the past means the register no longer backs this request. Wallets check the register before releasing attributes.

title: Credential type is not an EUDI-recognised identifier
source: EUDI Wallet Architecture and Reference Framework, PID and mDL identifiers
why: A private vct or doctype value is not a wallet-issued attestation, so nothing in the EUDI trust list will satisfy this query.
